content:
tara_manager: Quick heads-up  off-cycle promo approved by director for an IC from Eng II -> Senior Eng, effective 2025-10-01. Two asks: manager wants (1) a 1-year clawback on a hiring retention grant and (2) a band-exception because salary request is above band cap. What docs + approvals do we need?

lina_hr: Congrats! For clawbacks we need Legal + Comp signoff to include enforceable terms. For band exceptions: submit Role Change packet and mark "band exception" + attach manager rationale and market comps. Comp will route to Compensation Panel if above band.

mike_comp: To add: band exceptions require 3 docs: manager rationale (3 bullets), market data, and director justification. Panel meets weekly; mark "expedite" if counteroffer risk. For clawback language, we need a short clause: `retention grant subject to clawback if employee voluntarily separates within 12 months`  Legal will review.

jess_finance: Finance note: if approved above band and we fund the delta via headcount reserve we need cost-center approval. Also clarify if the retention grant is capitalized or expense for GL coding. Attach preferred budget code in packet.

michael_payroll: Payroll cutoff: to implement base + retention in pay period starting 2025-10-01, final approvals in payroll inbox by 2025-09-20 EOD. If clawback is approved, we need the grant schedule and the clawback terms before issuing the one-time payment so payroll can tag the payment metadata.

tara_manager: If employee leaves within 6 months, we want to claw back the full one-time. Is partial clawback OK? Manager prefers full recoup in first 6 months then 50% next 6 months.

lina_hr: That's a valid schedule. Include exact schedule in packet and attach draft agreement. Legal will confirm enforceability by jurisdiction. For EU employees this may be limited.

mike_comp: Also note: if the base increase pushes them above cap we might suggest alternative: approve base to cap + a one-time market adjustment (one-time taxable) instead of permanent above-band salary. That can simplify future banding and compensation planning.

jess_finance: Agree. One-time market adjustment is easier to reconcile in budget and reduces permanent salary pressure. But if manager insists on permanent above-band, prepare cost forecast for 12-24 months.

michael_payroll: Operational tip: if you choose base+one-time, include payroll comment: `apply one-time market adj in pay period 2025-10; permanent base set to X as of 2025-10-01` and include employee ID. That avoids duplicate payments.

tara_manager: Great. Two practical Qs: (A) can we backdate effective to 2025-09-01 without retro headaches? (B) what's the standard notice language for the clawback in offer letter?

lina_hr: (A) Backdating will likely cause retro pay unless approvals hit payroll before cutoff. Recommend stick to 2025-10-01 to avoid complexity. (B) Standard language: `Recipient acknowledges that the retention payment is contingent on continued employment; if the recipient voluntarily separates within 12 months, they agree to repay the specified portion of the payment as detailed in this agreement.` Attach that wording and Legal will tailor.

mike_comp: If there's a live external counteroffer, tag the packet "expedite" and include copy of counteroffer to speed panel.

tara_manager: Employee is US-based. Manager wants equity top-up with same clawback schedule. How does that interplay with cash clawback?

lina_hr: Equity clawbacks are handled separately by Compensation and Legal. Equity typically vests per schedule; clawback of unvested awards is straightforward (cancel unvested). Clawback of already vested shares is harder; usually we avoid clawback of vested equity due to logistical + legal constraints. Best to structure as forfeiture of unvested portion and cash clawback for payments.

jess_finance: For accounting, split the cash grant and equity grant in packet so Finance can code appropriately. If equity is subject to clawback of unvested portion, no immediate cash reconciliation needed.

michael_payroll: Final: once Role Change + Comp Adjustment + any grant forms are submitted, ping payroll with subject `Promo+Clawback | [Name] | Eff 2025-10-01` and include employee ID and preferred pay period for one-time.

tara_manager: Ok I'll submit Role Change packet + attach market comps, director email, proposed clawback wording, and note "expedite". Will ping when done. Thanks all. :pray:

people-ops-bot: Checklist reminder: Required Role Change fields: employee name, employee ID, current title, new title, proposed base, effective date, manager rationale, director approval, budget code. If requesting above-band exception add: market comps, director justification, and `expedite` flag if urgent. Links: HR portal https://hr.redwood.internal/role-change, Comp panel guide https://comp.redwood.internal/panel, Payroll deadlines https://payroll.redwood.internal/deadlines.
